_comment: The port lands in the existing scratchy crate, not a new one:
It consumes islands::sentient::Run<A, M, W> and produces islands::progir::Program<A, M, W>.
There is no MLIR text on either side and no parser in this crate: the input is a typed value and
the output is a typed value plus the twelve-line init.smc module.
⭐ REAL NESTED SUBMODULES, not `construct_*`/`lower_*` prefixed flat filenames. Bridge 2's homes
are flat agen_*/tf_*/vc_* files and that is on the record as the thing to not repeat.
No -sys crate: this is a complete port with no C interop boundary.

deeptools._comment_target_module: All ported code goes under src/bridges/sentient_to_progir/.

construct._comment: ConstructProgIRHelper.cpp (46 units) — one submodule per instruction family: scalar (jumps, compares, adds, subs, sync), compute (FMA, binary, unary, ternary), transfer (L3 and non-L3 loads and stores), mask_and_splat, opaque, reg_init.

lower._comment: LowerSentientHelper.cpp (34 units) — the per-operation handlers: transfer, compute, control (for/yield/sync/uniform), labels_and_regs.

uniform._comment: UniformInstrAndBlock.cpp and .hpp (33 units) — the operand map, one instruction's fields, and the block/region machinery with its flattened index.

driver._comment: SentientToProgIR.cpp (7 units) — runOnOperation, both GenerateProgIR overloads, GenerateProgIRForProgramUnit, initializeUtilizedRegisters, equalizeProgramLength, replaceProgramBodyWithSmcOp.

reg_def_tracker._comment: RegDefTracker.cpp (5 units) — which registers are defined, and whether anything reads one that is not. ⛔ A CHECK: returns the offenders, never refuses.

utils._comment: Utils.cpp (5 units) — the on-the-fly conversion check, the proper-consumer walk, the address wraparound, the fold-mode value.
